body:
The current draft source is **6876a805**. The existing Schwarzschild Transport test now checks the **complete inactive output allocation** before/after its original shrink/reorder/refusal/header-recovery calls, and requires nonzero-tail witnesses. Independent field, seven-RHS, tolerance and mixed-layer assertions remain intact.

[Complete finite control, source/format and CI evidence](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/tree/284c46028f4e8f0fdfbe3b4cc791faf73ef0e8ea/attestations/qualification/5ef09e1b/transport-inactive-capacity-and-private-ray-screen). Both stock and the private Transport prototype pass the two existing Transport cases with zero failures/errors/skips: **all four precision routes, 24 full-tail comparisons and 20 nonzero witnesses per arm**. Strict GCC14/Clang21 C++26 commands compile the strengthened observer. Runtime source is 5ef09e1b; the layout-only 6876a805 correction preserves 65,880 raw non-whitespace C++ tokens, so those completed runs are reused within that scope.

The eight-private-ray Transport prototype is **retired before a formal benefit trial**. Its actual ordinary JIT removes coroutine functions/allocator calls, uses 79,456 bytes of private vector arrays, and grows executable text 3.069%. The owned correctness runs take 160.208s (stock) and 299.061s (private) under the unchanged 300s governor. Those observations include compilation/correctness work and unisolated host activity; they are not a formal benchmark or causal timing attribution. **No fixed ABBA, remaining original eight controls, shader adoption, timing pooling/subtraction or unchanged failed frame rerun occurred.** Three earlier source/JIT/build owners and three current source/control owners all pass; the unchanged earlier archive is reused rather than duplicated.

[PR CI 39467671726](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/actions/runs/39467671726) passes all three strict Linux/Windows/macOS integration jobs and 30 original authority controls. Actual merge checkout d2d5f980 has the complete 6876a805 source tree; products retain that merge revision. Five full-qualification/diagnostic jobs were unrequested. Native-build/external-domain admission remains 0/8; science, full Mandatory, native interaction, required full frames and installed-release qualification remain open. PR #62 stays draft and main remains 5e706073.

The next concrete source lead is renderer ownership: [native devices are excluded from owner reuse](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/6876a8058a451eb0c8fedf8e3a6f8a8dfb16c210/src/sirius/render/vulkan_renderer.cpp#L439), and [cancellation retires the owner](https://github.com/sunyaisblank/Sirius/blob/6876a8058a451eb0c8fedf8e3a6f8a8dfb16c210/src/sirius/render/vulkan_renderer.cpp#L899). Review reuse only after session/executor shutdown and proven device quiescence, retaining identity/capacity/budget checks and retiring genuine device failures. Fresh per-frame state, coherent commits, the original cold-cache gates and all scientific/scene settings remain required. Actual native interaction latency and safe cancellation reuse have not yet been established for this lead.
